subject: website
name: UBNet Mail
summary: UBNet Mail, a page for registering a name.ubnet.eth mailbox and sending wallet mail: a readable script.js plus the vendored ethers and Spasm SDK (spasm-network/spasm.js, MIT) bundles, served as written (no licence file). It runs no third-party code. It relies on the UBNet server ubnet1.eth-ub.net for messages and submissions, so it is at most Level 3; it also loads Google Fonts and reads Ethereum from publicnode.

connections.name: ubnet1.eth-ub.net (UBNet message API)
connections.note: Messages and signed events go through this server when the user uses the mailbox.

connections.name: ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com
connections.note: Ethereum RPC read without a light client, called when the page opens.

connections.name: Google Fonts
connections.note: Stylesheet and font files fetched when the page opens; tells Google the visit.
